candle_consistency.rounding_assumption: Half of the final displayed decimal increment after K/M/B expansion. No omitted trailing zero is invented.
candle_consistency.limitation: Matching chart-local labels do not establish a verified UTC interval. Captures are asynchronous; values are retained without forcing agreement.

candle_consistency_history.limitation: Matching chart-local labels do not establish a verified UTC interval. Captures are asynchronous; values are retained without forcing agreement.

historical_chart_points.limitation: Historical public chart-local label only; UTC settlement time and status as the latest settled event are not established.

latest_displayed_historical_point.limitation: Historical public chart-local label only; UTC settlement time and status as the latest settled event are not established.

latest_captured_historical_point.limitation: Historical public chart-local label only; UTC settlement time and status as the latest settled event are not established.

funding.historical_note: Historical public chart points and untimestamped summaries are distinct from current predicted funding. UTC settlement times, account payments, and the latest settled rate are not established. The latest captured historical label is not automatically the latest chart endpoint.

visible_depth.limitation: Only five visible levels per side. Expanded K/M/B sizes and independent cumulative displays are approximate; no full book or sequence ID is available.

mark_prior_hour_comparison.limitation: Actual observation-to-observation mark change, not an exactly 60-minute return or timestamped exchange series.

research_threshold_scope: JCT only; other symbols are contextual observations.

alert_assessment.limitation: A threshold crossing is a research candidate only. A separate fresh same-contract read must confirm it before any alert; these files do not establish confirmation.

displayed_chart_sequence.sequence_basis: Fresh displayed chart sequence and hourly OI/taker controls verified by capturing worker; chart timezone remains unknown.
capture_recovery_notes: The capture operator reported a browser renderer failure during a funding-chart hover and recovery by reloading the public page. No cause was established.

A dated 10/13 12:00 funding tooltip was captured after recovery. Repeated attempts did not capture the expected 10/13 13:00 funding endpoint or the preceding hourly taker tooltip; those fields remain missing.
displayed_chart_sequence.interpretation: Chart-local labels only; adjacency does not identify UTC event time.

capture_operator_reported_recovery_notes: The capture operator reported a browser renderer failure during a funding-chart hover and recovery by reloading the public page. No cause was established.

A dated 10/13 12:00 funding tooltip was captured after recovery. Repeated attempts did not capture the expected 10/13 13:00 funding endpoint or the preceding hourly taker tooltip; those fields remain missing.
quality.empty_tooltip_policy: Captures without a complete dated OI, taker, or historical-funding tooltip do not supply that dated metric or any conclusions. Independently labeled funding summaries may be retained separately as untimestamped summaries, never as settlement events.
limitations: Signed-out public rendered UI only; values can refresh asynchronously.
Chart timezone unknown; no UTC or Beijing event-time conversion is made.
Running candles are excluded from all research thresholds.
Three named contracts only; STRK and KAIA are context, not alert subjects.
Rounded displayed volumes and five visible depth levels are not full-resolution exchange data.
The expected latest historical funding chart endpoint 10/13 13:00 was not captured; any older captured historical point and untimestamped summary are retained separately.
quality.unclassified_chart_note: A market capture does not by itself verify the selected chart interval. Such chart rows remain raw evidence; later stable explicit-interval captures supply normalized candles.

raw_capture_index_scope: Zero-based global indices in this 58-capture raw.json batch; only this symbol's raw captures are embedded below.
